description: Queue scoped follow-up guidance for a running child agent. It is delivered once at the child's next model-step boundary and does not expand the child's assignment.

propertyDescriptions.message: The scoped guidance for the child. Excess text is truncated to the configured message length.

guidance: Use message_subagent only to correct or narrow a running child's assigned work; a child that is stopping or terminal no longer accepts guidance.
